title: Snowy Wooden Footbridge
alt: A small arched wooden bridge over an icy stream with snow on its railings.
subject: A small arched wooden footbridge over a narrow icy blue stream, snow resting on two continuous handrails and the edges of its plank walkway. Four clearly connected upright posts, uneven stone banks at either end and a little irregular snow ground. Three-quarter view, believable wooden construction and open spaces below the railings.
